name: Amazon CloudFront - Web Operations
description: See information about web operations including Cache hits/misses, HTTP status codes over time,Traffic and Data volume served, Client and Server errors over time.
title: Amazon CloudFront - Web Operations

panels.title: Cache Hit and Miss Over Time

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{AccessLogsdatasource}}  ("hit" or "miss" or "RefreshHit")
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,time,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| timeslice 5m
|where cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}" AND method matches "{{method}}" AND user_agent matches "{{user_agent}}" AND edgeresult matches "{{edgeresult}}" AND status matches "{{status}}" AND uri_query matches "{{uri_query}}" AND edgeloc matches "{{edgeloc}}" AND c_ip matches "{{c_ip}}"
|count by edgeresult,_timeslice
| transpose row _timeslice column edgeresult

_sourceCategory={{AccessLogsdatasource}}  
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,time,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| timeslice by 1h
|where cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}" AND method matches "{{method}}" AND user_agent matches "{{user_agent}}" AND edgeresult matches "{{edgeresult}}" AND status matches "{{status}}" AND uri_query matches "{{uri_query}}" AND edgeloc matches "{{edgeloc}}" AND c_ip matches "{{c_ip}}"
|count as hits, sum(scbytes) as sum_bytes_served by _timeslice
| sum_bytes_served/(1048576) as mb_served | round(mb_served)
| fields - sum_bytes_served

_sourceCategory={{AccessLogsdatasource}}  | parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| timeslice by 5m
|where cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}" AND method matches "{{method}}" AND user_agent matches "{{user_agent}}" AND edgeresult matches "{{edgeresult}}" AND status matches "{{status}}" AND uri_query matches "{{uri_query}}" AND edgeloc matches "{{edgeloc}}" AND c_ip matches "{{c_ip}}"
|count by status, _timeslice 
| transpose row _timeslice column status
| fillmissing timeslice(5m)

panels.title: Client and Server Errors Over Time

queries.queryString:
_sourceCategory={{AccessLogsdatasource}}  | parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| timeslice by 5m | where status matches "4*" or status matches "5*"
| if(status matches "5*", "server_error", if(status matches "4*", "client_error", "other_error")) as type 
| timeslice by 5m
|where cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}" AND method matches "{{method}}" AND user_agent matches "{{user_agent}}" AND edgeresult matches "{{edgeresult}}" AND status matches "{{status}}" AND uri_query matches "{{uri_query}}" AND edgeloc matches "{{edgeloc}}" AND c_ip matches "{{c_ip}}"
|count by type, _timeslice | transpose row _timeslice column type

_sourceCategory={{AccessLogsdatasource}}  
| parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,time,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status_code,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid 
| if(status_code matches "2*", 1, 0) as successes | if(status_code matches "3*", 1, 0) as redirects | if(status_code matches "4*", 1, 0) as client_errors | if(status_code matches "5*", 1, 0) as server_errors | timeslice by 5m
|where cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}" AND method matches "{{method}}" AND user_agent matches "{{user_agent}}" AND edgeresult matches "{{edgeresult}}" AND status matches "{{status}}" AND uri_query matches "{{uri_query}}" AND edgeloc matches "{{edgeloc}}" AND c_ip matches "{{c_ip}}"
|sum(successes) as successes, sum(client_errors) as client_errors,  sum(redirects) as redirects, sum(server_errors) as server_errors by _timeslice
| fillmissing timeslice(5m) 
| sort by _timeslice asc

_sourceCategory={{AccessLogsdatasource}}  | parse "*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*\t*" as _filedate,_ftime,edgeloc, scbytes, c_ip,method,cs_host,uri_stem,status,referer,user_agent,uri_query,cookie,edgeresult,requestid
|where cs_host matches "{{cs_host}}" AND method matches "{{method}}" AND user_agent matches "{{user_agent}}" AND edgeresult matches "{{edgeresult}}" AND status matches "{{status}}" AND uri_query matches "{{uri_query}}" AND edgeloc matches "{{edgeloc}}" AND c_ip matches "{{c_ip}}"
|count by edgeresult | sort by _count
